finalTaskContracts: Shared objective and criteria, completion progress, current prerequisite acceptance and delegated checks
Overlapping file paths and explicit source-data truncation
Preparation does not accept or complete a task; accepted revision must be reviewed again
Historical applied receipt cannot stand for the current candidate and target
An uncertain application retains its original request identity for reconciliation
Reconciliation failure leaves session/task navigation usable; refresh restores the report

supplementalInspection.tool: agent-browser via CDP in an owned fixture browser
supplementalInspection.keyboard: Focused a task and opened its detail with Enter; selected a target and inspected the prepared diff.
supplementalInspection.note: Supplemental manual inspection preceded the final target-receipt comparison; the final focused keeper screenshots and tests above use the final build.

limits: The full 40-case suite was not rerun after the final receipt guard and keeper correction; both failed cases and affected flows passed in the final five-case run.
An earlier external-preview run was interrupted by SIGTERM; the later preview was owned by Playwright.
No paid inference, live-provider validation, publication or installed-service restart.
No public Protocol/HttpApi change; generated client files were not edited.
Preparation, verification, acceptance and application remain separate; the UI does not synthesize verification receipts.
Local Git worktrees on the trusted host only; cross-host integration, full execution waterfall, versioned shared context, grouped completion, reusable workflows and connectors remain open.
No claim of complete upstream parity or confirmed local vulnerability from upstream issue reports.
